source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source_name: Vicia ludoviciana subsp. leavenworthii (Torr. & A. Gray) Lassetter & C.R. Gunn

morphology_source_reported.peduncles: Flowers open before peduncle elongation; at flowering 0.5–3.5 cm long and 1/8–1/2 as long as subtending leaf; at fruit 2–8.5 cm

habitat_source_reported: Rocky, clayey or occasionally sandy prairies and roadsides
cautions: Kew accepts varietal rank and synonymizes 1999 Flora's subsp. leavenworthii; species-level morphology requires independent QA
Taxon concepts require independent name reconciliation before identification scoring
Regional occurrence is not evidence of local BONAP nativity
Peduncle length changes strongly from flowering to fruiting; season and stage are mandatory when using lengths to discriminate this variety.
accepted_name: Vicia ludoviciana var. leavenworthii (Torr. & A.Gray) Broich
